about: The owner's Mega Catch Cup (Great League Edition) party from 2026-11-24: Clodsire 1499 (lead), Thievul 1499, Snorlax 1500 (not shadow), as the Party tab shows them. Moves read off the three training battles (172928, 173119, 173245): Clodsire Stone Edge left, Earthquake right (names), fast Poison Sting or Mud Shot (the same energy; Spark's and Candela's teams cannot tell them apart by damage); Thievul Night Slash left (name), Play Rough right (the fills stand 1.75 to 1, so the right costs 60, not Icy Wind's 45), Sucker Punch (+7 a step on Night Slash's 35); Snorlax Body Slam left (name), Earthquake right (name; fills 1.63 to 1), Psywave (+4 a turn). No IVs or levels (PvPoke's defaults).
